description: With the ETW file-I/O recorder on the attempt's files: a new ACCDB with 4096 rows, closed; then OpenDatabase read-only (shared), a snapshot of SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(V) FROM T, a full scan of T, Close. Asks which reads, writes and flushes ACE issues, at which offsets and sizes, in which order, and which ones come from the lazy writer.
retentionNote: ETW file-I/O trace (show --etw; threads shown). WriteFile/FlushFileBuffers issue order is complete; paging (disk) writes are only partly attributed by the recorder. Setup ran in the exclusive CreateDatabase session: each statement writes its pages synchronously on the calling thread (2 bytes at 0xE00, pages, 0xE00 again; growth by a 1-byte write at the last byte of the new page), with no flush. OpenDatabase read-only shared: the database is opened share RW-, the lock file open-if and written 64 bytes at offset 0; scans issue reads only; no write and no flush of the database; Close deletes the .laccdb (RO-NATIVE).

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(20), V LONG, M MEMO)
INSERT INTO T (ID, K, V) SELECT a.n * 256 + b.n * 16 + c.n, CStr(c.n) & '-' & CStr(b.n) & '-' & CStr(a.n), a.n FROM S AS a, S AS b, S AS c
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(V) AS s FROM T
SELECT ID, K FROM T ORDER BY ID
